about_short_description.short_description: HTTPie is a software development company that designs an API management platform to create testing tools.

product.name: HTTPie for Terminal
product.description: A command-line HTTP client for testing and interacting with APIs and HTTP servers using a simple, human-friendly syntax.

product.name: HTTPie for Web & Desktop
product.description: A graphical user interface version of HTTPie that provides the features of the terminal client in a web and desktop application.

product.name: HTTPie AI
product.description: An AI-powered interface for interacting with APIs, enhancing the API testing and interaction experience.

product.name: HTTPie Plugin Manager
product.description: A tool to manage installation, listing, upgrading, and uninstallation of HTTPie plugins to extend its functionality.

product.name: HTTPie Sessions
product.description: A feature that enables persistent sessions to store and reuse HTTP headers, authentication, and cookies across multiple requests.

product.name: HTTPie Export/Import System
product.description: A system to export and import API request data, environments, collections, and workspaces in JSON format for backup, sharing, and publishing.
